messages:
lena: following up on the RFC review2: proposed 'seedless activation coordinator' playbook for air-gapped installs. goal: safe, low-touch atomic swaps without SSH into nodes.

sam: sounds promising. quick sketch of failure modes? power loss, partial write, manual tamper?

lena: agreed. proposed flow: 1) operator drops signed bundle+manifest to seed device 2) node agent pulls bundle, verifies signature+sha 3) agent stages bundle under staging/<bundle-id> (no activation) 4) agents publish signed staged-proof locally 5) coordinator (logical leader) gathers quorum of staged-proofs 6) coordinator writes sealed activation-marker referencing bundle-id and quorum 7) agents perform atomic activation (POSIX rename on same FS, WAL if cross-disk) 8) agents post signed activated-proof and health snapshot 9) coordinator verifies and triggers GC.

may: POSIX rename assumption is nice, but we need cross-fs fallback. whats the WAL pattern?

lena: WAL: write activation.transaction with per-file checksum map in target, fsync, then move files one-by-one with per-file .swap temp then rename. transaction allows reconcilers to finish or rollback after reboot.

raj: migrations concern: DB schema migrations might not be reentrant. how do we avoid double-run on retry?

lena: two options: prefer idempotent migrations, or require a single-node migration-runner operator invoked out-of-band. migration-runner writes a signed ledger entry when complete; coordinator waits for ledger before proceeding.

sam: coordinator is a single point of failure if naive. leader election?

lena: coordinator is logical. use leader election (Raft-style via controllers) or run on bootstrap host. marker is sealed with operator key/KMS so successor can resume safely.

ops-bot: deploy-bot dry-run: `airgapctl verify --bundle=bundle-2026-02 --mode=quorum` -> all nodes staged=true, checksums ok. :white_check_mark:

may: audit trail is required. signed events at each step please.

lena: yes: staged, ready, activated, health, gc events are signed and appended to local append-only log. coordinator mirrors proofs to control plane when reachable.

raj: tamper detection?

lena: agents verify staged files vs manifest sha256, mismatch sets staged=false and raises alert. coordinator halts activation on any mismatch.

sam: GC policy? dont want unbounded disk use.

lena: default keep last 3 bundles per node (active+staged), GC only after cluster-wide activation proof and operator window. operator can override.

raj: ok. next step: add small state diagram + CLI verbs (`stage`, `verify`, `activate`, `reconcile`, `gc`) to RFC appendix. i'll draft state machine.

lena: great. i'll add transaction-file semantics, leader-election details, and a compact manifest example in the appendix by EOW. :thumbsup:
